title: AGRO: ADVERSARIAL DISCOVERY OF ERROR-PRONE GROUPS FOR ROBUST OPTIMIZATION
benchmark_measurement: Robustness of toxicity classification for comments mentioning religious groups, specifically the 'other religions' group within the CivilComments dataset.
findings: The proposed AGRO method improves model performance on the 'Other Religions-Toxic' worst-group in the CivilComments dataset compared to the ERM baseline (66.7% vs 53.1% accuracy). However, other baseline methods like EIIL performed better on this specific religious subgroup (84.4%).
